meta.title: Eerste Gloed
meta.subtitle: NAGLOED v2 — SpectraStrobe proof-of-concept
meta.description: Four moments, much space in between. An amber-coloured light grain drifts from left to right and fades in 20 ms. 180 ms later a low impact answers with a non-identical envelope and a long decay. A weak light grain deliberately remains unanswered. Much later the gesture returns: reversed, lowered and dimmer.

envelope_rules.note: R4/R5 from docs/v2/SAFETY-PRIVACY.md: attack/release ≥ 20 ms hard, ≥ 50 ms for artistic events. L1 has a single isolated 20 ms extinction; L2 starts with a 50 ms fade-in.

carriers.note: Reference = -30 dBFS peak amplitude (binding, M2), continuously present; panning = equal-power pan law so that total carrier energy stays constant. Colours = direct channel amplitude with linear 0 dB centre panning (no -3 dB centre law). Hard safety clamp in render.py: every colour channel ≤ 25% of the reference peak; the sum per ear is reported separately (R3).

events.role: very sparse room image: one distant fragment

events.relation: response to L1 extinction, 180 ms later, different decay (2.5 s) than the light (20 ms)
transformation of A1; 400 ms after the start of L4

events.role: amber-coloured light grain: starts hard left, drifts slowly to the right, becomes slightly brighter
events.relation: the extinction at 14.0 s is the trigger for A1

events.role: diffuse amber-red field that slowly breathes and fades; the light outlives the sound
events.relation: afterglow after A1; no new audio answer

events.role: weak, cool light grain that fades by itself
events.relation: deliberately unanswered: no audio, no later return

events.role: dimmer, slower echo of L1: reversed movement, different timing
events.relation: remembered return of L1, 38 s later; transformation of A1 sounds 400 ms later

relations.detail: 180 ms after the 20 ms extinction; audio envelope 30 ms attack / 2.5 s decay, light 1.2 s attack / 20 ms extinction.
The diffuse amber-red glow keeps breathing after the impact is gone; no new sound.
The weak light grain at 38 s gets no audio and no later echo.
38 s later: L4 is a dimmer, slower, reversed echo; A2 is A1 reversed and lowered (pitch 0.75), 400 ms after the start of L4.

safety.stop: This offline WAV has NO encoder panic and NO tested 50 ms software ramp. Primary stop: stop playback + Kasina brightness to minimum + glasses off (or cover one eye).
safety.notes: Conservative first experiment: no intended luminance modulation in the colour channels; only slow colour transitions and one isolated 20 ms extinction. The 20 Hz reference panning is prescribed by the format and remains an open assumption (not a visible channel). Colours ≤ 25% per carrier (score 20%; ladder 6.25/12.5/20%). No medical or wellness claims.
